parameters.name: stateInvoice
parameters.description: Filter by invoice status.

schema.description:
Granular technical state of an invoice.

* `Draft` — basic draft (`Status` = `Draft`)
* `DraftCharging` — being charged; will be issued if the charge succeeds (`Draft`)
* `DueAuto` — due and automatically processed (`Due`)
* `DueOffline` — due; offline payment expected (`Due`)
* `DueToProcess` — due; will be processed later, for example in a batch (`Due`)
* `DuePending` — due; payment pending (`Due`)
* `Paid` — invoice paid (`Paid`)
* `PaidRefunded` — paid but subsequently refunded (`Paid`)
* `ProblemAuto` — automated payment encountered issues (`Problem`)
* `ProblemOverdue` — invoice overdue (`Problem`)
* `ProblemDisputed` — payment disputed (`Problem`)
* `Void` — cancelled before payment attempt (`Void`)
* `Uncollectible` — payment cannot be collected (`Uncollectible`)
schema.title: StateInvoice

schema.description:
Payment method.

* `Free` — subscription is free; no payment requested
* `ExternalCheck` — payment by check
* `ExternalCash` — payment by cash
* `ExternalBank` — payment by wire transfer
* `ExternalOther` — other external payment method
* `Card` — card payment with automated renewal
* `DirectDebit` — bank account debit with automated renewal
